feedback_driven.quote: PairRoute, an offline procedure that uses intermediate execution records to distinguish harness, model, and mixed failures. PairRoute proposes and evaluates targeted harness revisions

persists_across_tasks.quote: The resulting policies retain links to their supporting evidence and are updated as new observations arrive.

data.why_zh: PairRoute根据执行记录区分失败并修订harness，修订被选用于后续阶段，属控制流级harness演化。
